events.title: Yen Surrendering Half Intervention Gains - 158.37/USD, Weaponized Yen Framing
events.source: Bloomberg, CNBC, Straits Times, NAI 500, IFR
events.summary: Yen at 158.37 vs USD on Aug 7, well off 155.23 low from Aug 3 intervention. Nearly half of intervention gains erased. CNBC frames it as weaponized yen carry trade unwinding. 30Y UST at 5.274%, JGB 10Y at 2.85%. Investors rushing to hedge Japanese rates. BOJ intervention alone having limited impact over time per analysts.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Day 161 - Still Closed, Iran Ship Ban Bill Advancing, Houthis Threaten to Join War
events.source: IranSITREP, Britannica, NPR, The Hill, Wikipedia, Xinhua
events.summary: Hormuz remains closed as of Aug 7 1600 UTC. Iran parliament advancing bill to ban US/Israeli ships and charge tolls on others. Iran-Oman talks for joint venture to reopen. Houthis threaten to join war if US allies attack Iran, warned Bahrain and UAE. US and Iran say deal is close but both would have to back down. Trump held off planned strike on Iran Saturday night.

events.title: Ebola Now Second Worst Outbreak Ever - Childhood Deaths Rising, Vaccine Months Away
events.source: WHO, ECDC, CDC, UN News, The Atlantic, Wikipedia
events.summary: Africa CDC declares it second worst Ebola outbreak ever. Fastest-growing on record. Bundibugyo strain has no existing vaccine. WHO says vaccine results may be months away. Childhood deaths rising in DRC. Spread to Uganda. Testing falling short per The Atlantic. WHO PHEIC active since May 16.

events.title: China Property Sales Falling Again - Brief Recovery Reverses, PBOC Pledges Loose Policy
events.summary: May optimism about China real estate recovery proved premature. Sales falling sharply again. PBOC pledging appropriately loose monetary policy for H2 2026. Home prices at 21-year low. Household wealth destruction compared to US 2008 scale. Jobs at risk from construction slowdown.

events.title: France Fiscal Crisis - EUR107B H1 Deficit, 8% Deficit Ratio, ECB Banking Data Shows Growing Sovereign Exposures
events.source: ECB, ESM, Futunn, ZeroHedge, House of Commons Library
events.summary: France central government deficit EUR107B in H1 2026. Full-year deficit potentially 8%. ECB published consolidated banking data showing growing sovereign exposures on bank balance sheets. ESM warns of euro area resilience under strain. ECB rates at 2.25%, markets pricing 40bps of hikes. German figures warning of contagion.

events.title: Oil at $78, Gold at $4,350+ - OPEC+ Rollback Continues, Safe Haven Demand Surging
events.summary: Brent at ~$78/bbl (up 22% YoY). OPEC+ rollback continuing +188K bpd September. Gold at $4,350+ (up 28% YoY). WTI range $67-106. India vulnerable to supply disruption if Hormuz stays closed through September. World Bank projects 24% energy price surge in 2026.

events.title: South Korea KOSPI Aftermath - Won Supported by Intervention Risks, Semiconductor Selloff Ongoing
events.summary: KOSPI circuit breaker aftermath continues. Won at 1,415/USD but strengthening on intervention risks. DBS stays short USD/KRW. Semiconductor selloff ongoing from SanDisk guidance disappointment. Terms-of-trade boom from AI demand. Thailand also saw circuit breakers.

events.title: Russia Banking Crisis - Sberbank Warns on NPLs, Bankruptcies Rising 13.7% YoY
events.summary: Russia banking stress ongoing. Record 636,000 bankruptcies. Sberbank warns of rising corporate credit risks. 11.7% of corporate loans classified problematic. Total problematic loans: 13.4 trillion rubles ($167.5B). Banks increasing provisions, restructuring debts.

events.title: US Jobs Report - Hiring Slumps, Labor Market May Be Breaking, Fed Hike Odds Drop
events.source: BLS, NYT, Bloomberg, CBS News, Quartz, Cleveland Fed
events.summary: July 2026 jobs report missed forecasts. BLS data shows hiring slumping. NYT says labor market may be breaking. Fed September hike odds dropped to 44% (from 55%) per CME FedWatch. S&P 500 rallied on the miss. Fed now expected to hold rates at 3.50-3.75% for fifth consecutive meeting. Inflation nowcasting shows continued pressure but labor weakening may override.

events.title: Brazil-Argentina Diplomatic Crisis - 40-Year Low, Ambassador Withdrawn, Mercosur at Risk
events.source: Folha, Xinhua, Orinoco Tribune, India Sentinels, Nomad Lawyer, Buenos Aires Times
events.summary: Brazil downgraded diplomatic relations with Argentina to charge d'affaires level. Ambassador Julio Bitelli withdrawn. Milei repeatedly called Lula corrupt and convicted. Lowest point in 40 years of relations. Argentina Merval fell 1.76%, peso at 1,500/USD. Argentina extended currency swap with China. Mercosur cooperation at risk.

events.title: Europe Energy Grid Stress - Paks Nuclear at 1/8 Turbines, Danube Historic Lows, Diesel Margins 20-Year Highs
events.source: New Scientist, Politico, OilPrice.com, Wikipedia, No2NuclearPower, Pravda Hungary
events.summary: Record-breaking European heatwave disrupting energy system. Paks nuclear plant (40% of Hungary electricity) shut down 7 of 8 turbines due to Danube drought. Nuclear plants in Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria affected. Diesel refining margins at 20-year highs. Netherlands imposed water restrictions Aug 5. Megafires in Spain, France, Greece costing billions. Hungary near energy crisis.
